Number(repeatMatch[1]) : value.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length; }; const setLayout = async (layout) => { const res = await window.api.settings.update({ layout }); if (!res || !res.ok) throw new Error('settings.update(' + layout + ') 失败: ' + JSON.stringify(res)); await sleep(650); const grid = findGrid(); if (!grid) throw new Error('切换到 ' + layout + ' 后找不到卡片网格'); return grid; }; const four = await setLayout('grid-4'); const fourColumns = columnsOf(four); if (fourColumns !== 4) throw new Error('requested=grid-4 应渲染 4 列，实际 ' + fourColumns); const fourCards = four.children.length; const rects = Array.from(four.children).map((el) => el.getBoundingClientRect()); for (const rect of rects) { if (rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) throw new Error('grid-4 存在零尺寸卡片'); } const persisted4 = await window.api.settings.get(); if (!persisted4.ok || persisted4.data.layout !== 'grid-4') throw new Error('grid-4 未持久化: ' + JSON.stringify(persisted4.data && persisted4.data.layout)); const two = await setLayout('grid-2'); const twoColumns = columnsOf(two); if (twoColumns !== 2) throw new Error('切换 grid-2 后应渲染 2 列，实际 ' + twoColumns); const persisted2 = await window.api.settings.get(); if (!persisted2.ok || persisted2.data.layout !== 'grid-2') throw new Error('grid-2 未持久化: ' + JSON.stringify(persisted2.data && persisted2.data.layout)); const back = await setLayout('grid-4'); const backColumns = columnsOf(back); if (backColumns !== 4) throw new Error('切回 grid-4 后应渲染 4 列，实际 ' + backColumns); const documentOverflow = Math.max(document.documentElement.scrollWidth, document.body.scrollWidth) - width; if (documentOverflow > 1) throw new Error('文档横向溢出 ' + documentOverflow + 'px'); return { width, fourColumns, fourCards, twoColumns, backColumns, documentOverflow }; })()
